headline: A new law renames a St. Charles, Illinois post office as the Veterans of the Vietnam War Memorial Post Office.
what_it_does: The law gives an official name to the U.S. Postal Service facility at 616 East Main Street in St. Charles, Illinois. The new name is the Veterans of the Vietnam War Memorial Post Office. It changes only the name of the building and does not change postal services or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on May 7, 2024, and took effect on that date.
